gitCommit.subject: api: error-handling sweep — ZodError→400, finalize 409, signup timing (pv9 PR2) (#236)
gitCommit.body:
api: error-handling sweep — ZodError→400, finalize 409, signup timing (pv9 PR2) (#236)

* feat(api): FinalizeStateError + errorResponse helper (purses-ydph, purses-7jds)

Add FinalizeStateError to SortResultService mirroring Delete/SupersedeStateError.
Add state guard in ResultController.finalizeResult (finalized→throws FinalizeStateError).
Create src/server/api/http-errors.ts with errorResponse(error) mapping all typed
errors to canonical HTTP statuses (SyntaxError→400, ZodError→400, state errors→409,
Unauthorized→401, else→500). Unit-tested 9 branches in http-errors.test.ts.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(api): roll out errorResponse across routes; flip pins RED→GREEN (purses-7jds, purses-4wj2, purses-ydph)

Apply errorResponse(error) to every route that previously swallowed ZodError/state
errors as 500: collections/[id]/items POST, items POST, collections/[id]/invitations POST,
sort-results/[id]/finalize POST, sort-results/[id]/items/[rid] GET+PATCH+DELETE,
sort-results/[id]/shares GET+POST, sort-results/[id]/shares/[sid] GET+PATCH+DELETE,
users/me PATCH. ZodError->400, FinalizeStateError->409, UnauthorizedError->401.

Add UnauthorizedError to mockAuth factory and inline vi.hoisted mocks so errorResponse's
instanceof check resolves correctly under all test mock patterns.

Pins flipped (RED->GREEN): re-finalize 200->409; bad-enum PATCH 500->400; items-POST
missing-name throw->400; items/route POST 500->400; invitation missing/malformed email
500->400; users/me empty-name PATCH 500->400.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(security): equalize signup dup-email timing (purses-zeyd)

In the existing-user branch, run await bcrypt.hash(password, 12) (throwaway result)
before the early 201 return so the duplicate-email path spends equivalent CPU time
to the real signup path. Eliminates the timing oracle that leaked email existence.
No change to the 201 response or the single-row assertion in the integration test.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(api): complete errorResponse rollout — ZodError->400 on all body-parsing routes (purses-pv9)

Finish the §5.2 rollout the PR2 review flagged as half-migrated. Route every
remaining catch on a route whose controller .parse()es the request body through
errorResponse(error), so ZodError maps to 400 (not 500). Authz/guard returns
(401/403/404, instanceof NextResponse early-returns) stay BEFORE the try; no
authz behavior changes; no 404-from-message mapping introduced.

Routes:
- items/[id] PATCH (updateItem) + GET/DELETE catches unified
- collections POST (createCollection) + GET catch unified
- collections/[id] PATCH (updateCollection) + GET/DELETE catches unified
- collections/[id]/members POST (addMember) + GET catch unified
- collections/[id]/members/[mid] PATCH (updateMember) — wrap final call (was unhandled 500)
- invitations/[id] PATCH (updateInvitation) + GET/DELETE catches unified
- sessions/[id] PATCH (updateSession) — wrap final call (was unhandled 500)
- sort-results/[id] PATCH (updateResult) + GET/DELETE catches unified
  (DELETE's DeleteResultStateError->409 preserved via errorResponse)

Tests (integration-over-mocked, real DB, assert state on the negative path):
- new validation->400 case per route (invalid body -> 400 + no row written/changed)
- flipped core-routes collections-POST missing-name 500->400 (with no-row state)
- added UnauthorizedError to the inline @/lib/auth mocks in members-routes,
  sessions-routes, sort-pipeline so errorResponse's instanceof check resolves

Out of scope (verified no request-body .parse()): preferences items/recalculate,
audit, purge, archive/restore, remove-from-sorts, item restore/purge,
sort-results items GET / reset / supersede, invitations resend, decisions POST
(interface cast, no parse), collections items/[itemId] PATCH (already 400).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* docs(api): finalize 409 + consistent validation-400/state-409 (pv9 PR2)

Refs: purses-ydph, purses-7jds, purses-4wj2

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
